seed_ledger.name: Parker power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: The plant is Fort Worth Power Core LLC (CEO Rhett Bennett, Black Mountain) at 501 Pearson Ranch Road near Weatherford, Parker County. The Star-Telegram reports Texas air permit approval in April 2025 for five gas turbines described as backup or bridge power for a new data center, on a 2,000-acre Black Mountain tract with no data center yet under development. No source names the gas supplier, a tap on Texas Intrastate System (P0264, 0.2 km) or a lateral. The city of Weatherford says it was never notified of the project. Sources checked: Star-Telegram via Yahoo (turbines, owner, no gas supply); city of Weatherford statement (no gas detail); datacenterhawk listing (site only); TCEQ and Railroad Commission records (not searchable by name); Atmos, Energy Transfer and Enterprise searches (nothing for this site); county commissioner coverage (no gas detail). Searches run: 11.

evidence.note: five gas turbines at 501 Pearson Ranch Road approved April 2025 as backup/bridge power for a new data center; no gas supply named
